name: @xpert-ai/plugin-excalidraw
description: Collaborative Excalidraw app with Yjs live editing, secure interactive HTML Artifact sharing, DiagramIR templates, quality review, versions, and an editable workbench.
author: XpertAI

interface.longDescription: Create, co-edit, version, review, import, export, and share Agent-generated Excalidraw diagrams. Live collaboration uses platform-owned Yjs documents and presence. Sharing publishes a safe self-contained read-only Excalidraw HTML viewer through platform Artifacts with controlled access and revocation. The optional technical diagram engine adds templates, DiagramIR, deterministic rendering, and quality review.
defaultPrompt: Turn this flow into an Excalidraw drawing
Update the current Excalidraw canvas from my feedback
Create and visually review a RAG architecture from a built-in template

description.en_US: Skill for using Excalidraw middleware tools, Workbench selection context, scene inspection, patching, versioning, and recovery.
description.zh_Hans: 使用 Excalidraw 中间件工具、工作台选择上下文、场景检查、修补、版本管理和恢复的技能。

description.en_US: Assistant template for Excalidraw drawing workflows.
description.zh_Hans: 面向 Excalidraw 绘图工作流的助手模板。

description.en_US: Template selection, semantic DiagramIR modeling, deterministic validation, preview inspection, and bounded visual correction.
description.zh_Hans: 模板选择、DiagramIR 语义建模、确定性校验、预览检查和有界视觉修正。

description.en_US: Assistant template for the full template-to-DiagramIR quality workflow.
description.zh_Hans: 执行从模板到 DiagramIR 再到质量闭环的助手模板。

description.en_US: Create editable diagrams with AI, collaborate on the canvas, and share reviewed versions.
description.zh_Hans: 用 AI 创作可编辑图形，在画布中协作，并分享经过审阅的版本。

description.en_US: Shared organization workspace for diagram creation, canvas review, and drawing history.
description.zh_Hans: 用于图形创作、画布审阅和版本管理的组织共享工作空间。

tagline.en_US: From an idea to an editable diagram
tagline.zh_Hans: 让想法成为可以继续编辑的图形

longDescription.en_US: Describe a flowchart, architecture, wireframe, or whiteboard to the Drawing Assistant, then refine the same scene in Excalidraw Workbench. The plugin also includes technical diagram templates, quality checks, and native MCP tools with interactive previews for external clients.
longDescription.zh_Hans: 向绘图助手描述流程、架构、线框图或白板想法，再在 Excalidraw 工作台中继续完善同一份场景。插件还提供技术图模板、质量检查，以及供外部客户端使用的原生 MCP 工具和交互预览。

description.en_US: Create with natural language and refine elements together in the live Excalidraw canvas.
description.zh_Hans: 用自然语言生成图形，与同事在实时同步的 Excalidraw 画布中调整元素。

description.en_US: Save checkpoints, restore earlier versions, export JSON/SVG/PNG, and publish revocable public Artifact links.
description.zh_Hans: 保存检查点、恢复历史版本、导出 JSON/SVG/PNG，并发布可撤销的公开 Artifact 链接。

description.en_US: Use the separately available Technical Diagram Assistant template for DiagramIR layout, validation, and visual review.
description.zh_Hans: 按需使用独立提供的技术图助手模板，完成 DiagramIR 布局、校验与视觉审核。

title.zh_Hans: 原生 MCP 工具与预览

description.en_US: Connect an authorized MCP client to create, convert, and preview drawings without opening Workbench.
description.zh_Hans: 连接已授权的 MCP 客户端，无需打开工作台即可创建、转换和预览图形。

useCases.zh_Hans: 流程图与业务流程审阅

dataScope.en_US: The application workspace is shared within the current organization. Authorized MCP clients can access drawings across that organization. Tools run directly under the application policy, including public sharing; links can be revoked.
dataScope.zh_Hans: 应用工作空间在当前组织内共享。已授权的 MCP 客户端可访问当前组织内的图形。工具按应用策略直接执行，包括公开分享；已发布的链接可以撤销。

initializationSummary.en_US: Xpert creates a dedicated organization workspace, installs the Drawing Assistant and its dependencies, and publishes its chat entry. An organization-visible language model is required.
initializationSummary.zh_Hans: Xpert 将创建组织专用工作空间，安装绘图助手及其依赖，并发布对话入口。初始化需要组织内可用的语言模型。

initializationSteps.zh_Hans: 创建共享绘图工作空间

initializationSteps.en_US: Install the Drawing Assistant and its dependencies
initializationSteps.zh_Hans: 安装绘图助手及其依赖
